race.comment: DETORON (11) is the horse to beat after scoring at Mildura over 2000m, where she beat Pendante by just under a length and justified her position near the top of betting. The rise from picnic company is the obvious new challenge, but she arrives in winning form, Jemma Gutte stays aboard after winning on her and the 2kg claim is useful. TEE EIGHT (9) comes through stronger metro company after finishing sixth over 2525m at Morphettville, beaten just over five lengths after covering ground. His 1800m record is the query, but this looks a more suitable assignment. OUR BEAU (4) worked home well for third at Bordertown on soft ground after covering ground, and the prior Morphettville Class 1 run had enough excuse with keenness and a home-straight hampering. HOTCH POTCH (8) was steadied near the 400m when seventh in a BM58 at Bordertown, and the class drop plus a prior placing at this track and distance makes him a contender if he sharpens off that run.
